verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUMUTENDE ye
Mmwe eb'omu bbanga
Ne bakkerubi
-Olw'obutonzi bwe.
Mmwe-eggulu musuute
Eyabatonda;
Mumuvuunamire
Mu bukulu bwe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mumutende ye
Mmwe ab'oku nsi,
Mukube-ennanga
Mmwe abalonde be.
Mumutende-olwa byonna
Eby'ekisa kye;
Musuute-eyabawa
Okuyimbanga.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mumutende ye
Mmwe ebivuga
-Eby'engeri zonna
-Ez'amaloboozi.
Mukube nnyo-ennanga
Lw'ekitiibwa kye,
Mmwe-ebitaasa mwenna
Mumuwe-ettendo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mumutende ye
Era mwebaze,
Mu biro byonna
Mumusuutenga;
Eyatwagala-ennyo
N'atununula
Atenderezebwe
-Emirenbe gyonna
